product_launches.description: Epsilon3 launched Epsilon3 2.0, a major new version of its operations platform that unifies workflows, data, collaboration, inventory, quality, procurement, and traceability, including new Connect, Dashboards, and MCP Server capabilities for high‑stakes industries.

press_references.value: Epsilon3 Listed in AWS "ICMP" for the US Federal Government

product_launches.description: Epsilon3 announced that its Procedure & Resource Management Platform is now listed and available to U.S. government customers in the AWS Marketplace for the U.S. Intelligence Community (ICMP).

press_references.value: Epsilon3 Launches FedRAMP High Solution: The First Government-Grade Procedure Execution Software

product_launches.description: Epsilon3 launched its FedRAMP High Authorized procedure execution software, becoming the first government-grade solution of its kind. This product meets the U.S. government's most stringent cloud security requirements, enabling federal agencies and contractors to securely manage sensitive operations.

overview_description.description: Epsilon3 is building the future of spacecraft and complex operations software. Epsilon3 is committed to modernizing space missions and complex engineering and testing by building the industry standard of operational software. Epsilon3 gives operators the best possible tools throughout an entire project’s lifecycle, which results in 10X more efficiency and operator-friendliness.

about_short_description.short_description: Epsilon3 is the OS for spacecraft and complex operations.

product.name: Epsilon3 Platform
product.description: A cloud-based operations platform for planning, manufacturing, testing, procedure execution, data analysis, and lifecycle management of spacecraft and other complex systems.

product.name: Plan: Schedules, Orders, & Operations
product.description: A planning and scheduling module for coordinating operations, work orders, calendars, dependencies, milestones, notifications, and operational activities.

product.name: Execute: Procedures & Workflows
product.description: An electronic procedure and workflow module for creating, reviewing, executing, revising, and tracking standard operating procedures.

product.name: Build: Manufacturing Execution System
product.description: A manufacturing execution module for managing parts, inventory, tools, quality activities, assembly instructions, work orders, and as-built product records.

product.name: Test: Cases, Plans, & Requirements
product.description: A test and requirements management module for defining specifications, conditions, requirements, test cases, test plans, and verification activities.

product.name: Analyze: Data & Reporting
product.description: A data-management and reporting module for storing, visualizing, and analyzing operational, telemetry, test, performance, and time-series data.
